snippet.title: Golf 5 eClub Trailer
snippet.description: Introducing Golf5 eclub, a truly immersive golf experience - real swing, real handicap, and real competitions from anywhere in the world. A powerful driver golf shot ignites the overview of the game. Amazing VR golf play, audio and visuals while playing the 18 hole golf course, practicing at the driving range, enjoying the mini golf or discovering all the playing modes.
